surfaces.label: GET /pricing ?tier query parameter (src/app/pricing/page.tsx:537-544)
surfaces.notes: candidate-c2cde6d450e560cc: validation=suppressed. Strict-equality allowlist over three constant slugs with tiers[0] fallback; nine crafted values rendered through the real page: none reflected, none altered a link, none threw.
surfaces.riskArea: Reflected XSS / content injection / link tampering

surfaces.label: /login credential form (src/app/login/page.tsx:21)
surfaces.notes: candidate-27894790d5bbed1b: validation=suppressed. Non-functional template form: POSTs to the same first-party route over HTTPS; Next classifies it as an unsupported URL-encoded MPA action and renders the page; no code reads or stores the body. Product follow-up: link to the real app login or remove the form.

surfaces.label: HTTP response headers and CSP (next.config.mjs:8-11)
surfaces.notes: candidate-d997de2ed46e4ca6: validation=reportable, attack_path=ignore (impact ignore, likelihood high, severity ignore). No headers() and no middleware; built routes-manifest headers []. Nothing state-changing to frame and no injection sink for CSP to backstop, so policy ignore. Hardening backlog: frame-ancestors none, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy, HSTS, CSP allowing self plus api.fontshare.com.
surfaces.riskArea: Clickjacking / missing CSP and transport headers

surfaces.label: Fontshare stylesheet in the root layout (src/app/layout.tsx:19-22)
surfaces.notes: candidate-a8440707cf39bd09: validation=reportable, attack_path=ignore (impact low, likelihood ignore, severity ignore). CSS-only capability, needs a Fontshare compromise; SRI impossible on dynamic font CSS. Self-hosting Switzer would also stop sending every visitor IP to a third party.

surfaces.label: Pricing CTAs to Stripe/zcal with target=_blank (src/app/pricing/page.tsx:203)
surfaces.notes: candidate-847925d58617afa4: validation=suppressed. Anchors render target=_blank without rel (next/link adds none), but browsers imply noopener for target=_blank and the destinations are constant Stripe/zcal URLs. The job modal mailto uses noopener,noreferrer explicitly.

surfaces.label: Default-enabled /_next/image on this branch (next.config.mjs, Next 16.4.1)
surfaces.notes: candidate-a4f467a486d58c3c: validation=suppressed. DEDUP: production main (Next 14.2.11) optimizer exposure is decision 58f292806fd7, and the images.unoptimized mitigation is tracked separately; this row checks the branch only. Real validator: remote/metadata URLs rejected (remotePatterns []), SVG disallowed, 15 widths x q75 x webp, cached 4 h; local hrefs re-enter Next routing as a mocked GET.

surfaces.label: EXIF/XMP metadata in served images under public/
surfaces.notes: candidate-081c3af2ede93d08: validation=reportable, attack_path=ignore (impact ignore, likelihood high, severity ignore). No GPS in any of 29 rasters; camera model, capture dates, and one photographer name plus camera serial (harriet-chan.jpg). Strip on export as hygiene.

surfaces.label: Amplify build spec and dependency install (amplify.yml, pnpm-lock.yaml)
surfaces.notes: candidate-2744ce1791fbece2: validation=reportable, attack_path=ignore (impact high, likelihood ignore, severity ignore). Exact pins, 224/224 sha512 lockfile entries, registry-only sources, no allowlisted lifecycle scripts. Residual gaps (global pnpm without repo-pinned hash, cached node_modules) need repo/Amplify control or registry compromise. Hardening: packageManager +sha512 via corepack; cache the pnpm store, not node_modules.

surfaces.label: Same-origin SVG assets under public/ (24 files)
surfaces.notes: Affirmative review: every SVG parsed with xml.etree and its full element/attribute inventory checked; only inert shapes, no script/foreignObject/on* handlers/external href or url(). adobe-creative-cloud.svg embeds an inert data:image/png.
surfaces.riskArea: Stored XSS via active SVG content

surfaces.label: All runtime source under src/ (31 files: 8 app routes, 22 components, 1 stylesheet)
surfaces.notes: Affirmative review: every file read in full (keyboard.tsx via a structural filter that printed all non-SVG-path lines). All rendered data is constant; client components handle only UI state. Corroborated by the sink searches in negative_searches.txt.
surfaces.riskArea: XSS / DOM sinks / unsafe client logic

surfaces.label: Dependency manifest, lockfile and package-manager config
surfaces.notes: Structural review of all 224 lockfile package entries (sha512 on every one, registry sources only); .npmrc and pnpm-workspace.yaml carry no registry override or token. Advisory currency of the pinned versions is not judged here (see open questions; owned by the dependency lens).

surfaces.label: docs/, README, CHANGELOG, LICENSE, .claude/ agent tooling
surfaces.notes: Affirmative review: read in full. Not served by Next. Agent tooling instructs read-only git and aws list/get commands under developer control.

surfaces.label: Route handlers, API routes, middleware/proxy, server actions, RSC action decoding
surfaces.notes: NEGATIVE SEARCH: no route/middleware/proxy files, no "use server"; built server-reference manifest is empty, so Next rejects multipart and fetch action requests before decoding (action-handler.js:415-419).

surfaces.label: Authentication, sessions, cookies, authorization, CSRF
surfaces.notes: NEGATIVE SEARCH: no cookies(), headers(), session, or auth code in src/; the only form is the non-functional /login template.

surfaces.label: Server-side fetch, filesystem, process, env, database access in application code
surfaces.notes: NEGATIVE SEARCH: no fetch/axios/http, fs, child_process, process.env or DB client in src/ or package.json dependencies.
